How to Play

  1. Create an account or login to your existing one
  2. Choose your preferred game mode (Free Play or Betting)
  3. Join a game room or create your own
  4. Wait for other players to join (2-4 players required)
  1. Roll the dice on your turn
  2. Move your tokens strategically
  3. Capture opponent tokens and avoid being captured
  4. Get all your tokens to the home triangle to win!
